SELECT
    v.CUSTOMER_ID,
    MAX(v.EVENT_TIMESTAMP) AS LAST_UPDATED,
    MAX(v.TXN_COUNT_1H) AS TXN_COUNT_1H,
    MAX(v.TXN_COUNT_24H) AS TXN_COUNT_24H,
    MAX(v.TXN_AMOUNT_1H) AS TXN_AMOUNT_1H,
    MAX(v.TXN_AMOUNT_24H) AS TXN_AMOUNT_24H,
    MAX(v.DISTINCT_MERCHANTS_24H) AS DISTINCT_MERCHANTS_24H,
    MAX(v.RECENT_TXN_COUNT) AS RECENT_TXN_COUNT,
    MAX(v.RECENT_TXN_AMOUNT) AS RECENT_TXN_AMOUNT,
    MAX(v.FRAUD_RATE_7D) AS FRAUD_RATE_7D
FROM DEMO_DEV.FRAUD_INTELLIGENCE.stg_raw_velocity_events v
GROUP BY v.CUSTOMER_ID

SELECT
    c.CUSTOMER_ID,
    c.FULL_NAME,
    c.RISK_SEGMENT,
    c.KYC_COMPLETE,
    c.IS_SYNTHETIC_FLAG,
    c.IS_MERGER_DUP_FLAG,
    c.ACCOUNT_COUNT,
    c.CUSTOMER_TENURE_DAYS,
    DATEDIFF(DAY, c.CUSTOMER_SINCE, CURRENT_DATE()) AS MIN_ACCOUNT_AGE_DAYS,
    DATEDIFF(DAY, c.CUSTOMER_SINCE, CURRENT_DATE()) AS MAX_ACCOUNT_AGE_DAYS,
    COALESCE(alert_counts.PRIOR_ALERT_COUNT, 0) AS PRIOR_ALERT_COUNT,
    c.INGESTED_AT AS DBT_LOADED_AT
FROM DEMO_DEV.FRAUD_INTELLIGENCE.stg_raw_customers c
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT CUSTOMER_ID, COUNT(*) AS PRIOR_ALERT_COUNT
    FROM DEMO_DEV.FRAUD_INTELLIGENCE.stg_raw_alerts
    GROUP BY CUSTOMER_ID
) alert_counts ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = alert_counts.CUSTOMER_ID

SELECT
    t.TRANSACTION_ID,
    t.CUSTOMER_ID,
    t.TRANSACTION_AMOUNT,
    t.TRANSACTION_TYPE,
    t.MERCHANT_CATEGORY,
    t.CHANNEL,
    DATEDIFF(DAY, c.CUSTOMER_SINCE, t.TRANSACTION_DATE) AS ACCOUNT_AGE_DAYS,
    t.TRANSACTION_AMOUNT * 10 AS CREDIT_LIMIT,
    t.TRANSACTION_AMOUNT * 3 AS CURRENT_BALANCE,
    COALESCE(t.ACCOUNT_ID, 'UNKNOWN') AS ACCOUNT_TYPE,
    CASE
        WHEN t.TRANSACTION_AMOUNT * 10 > 0
            THEN ROUND((t.TRANSACTION_AMOUNT * 3) / (t.TRANSACTION_AMOUNT * 10), 4)
        ELSE 0
    END AS UTILIZATION_RATIO,
    c.RISK_SEGMENT,
    c.KYC_COMPLETE,
    0 AS ADDRESS_CHANGE_COUNT,
    c.IS_SYNTHETIC_FLAG,
    c.IS_MERGER_DUP_FLAG,
    c.CUSTOMER_TENURE_DAYS,
    COALESCE(alert_counts.PRIOR_ALERT_COUNT, 0) AS PRIOR_ALERT_COUNT_CUSTOMER,
    COALESCE(alert_7d.ALERT_WITHIN_7D, 0) AS ALERT_WITHIN_7D,
    COALESCE(v.TXN_COUNT_1H, 0) AS TXN_COUNT_1H,
    COALESCE(v.TXN_COUNT_24H, 0) AS TXN_COUNT_24H,
    COALESCE(v.TXN_AMOUNT_1H, 0) AS TXN_AMOUNT_1H,
    COALESCE(v.TXN_AMOUNT_24H, 0) AS TXN_AMOUNT_24H,
    COALESCE(v.DISTINCT_MERCHANTS_24H, 0) AS DISTINCT_MERCHANTS_24H
FROM DEMO_DEV.FRAUD_INTELLIGENCE.stg_raw_transactions t
LEFT JOIN DEMO_DEV.FRAUD_INTELLIGENCE.stg_raw_customers c
    ON t.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT CUSTOMER_ID, MAX(TXN_COUNT_1H) AS TXN_COUNT_1H, MAX(TXN_COUNT_24H) AS TXN_COUNT_24H,
           MAX(TXN_AMOUNT_1H) AS TXN_AMOUNT_1H, MAX(TXN_AMOUNT_24H) AS TXN_AMOUNT_24H,
           MAX(DISTINCT_MERCHANTS_24H) AS DISTINCT_MERCHANTS_24H
    FROM DEMO_DEV.FRAUD_INTELLIGENCE.stg_raw_velocity_events
    GROUP BY CUSTOMER_ID
) v ON t.CUSTOMER_ID = v.CUSTOMER_ID
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT CUSTOMER_ID, COUNT(*) AS PRIOR_ALERT_COUNT
    FROM DEMO_DEV.FRAUD_INTELLIGENCE.stg_raw_alerts
    GROUP BY CUSTOMER_ID
) alert_counts ON t.CUSTOMER_ID = alert_counts.CUSTOMER_ID
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT CUSTOMER_ID, COUNT(*) AS ALERT_WITHIN_7D
    FROM DEMO_DEV.FRAUD_INTELLIGENCE.stg_raw_alerts
    WHERE ALERT_DATE >= DATEADD(DAY, -7, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())
    GROUP BY CUSTOMER_ID
) alert_7d ON t.CUSTOMER_ID = alert_7d.CUSTOMER_ID

WITH deduped AS (
    SELECT
        a.ALERT_ID,
        a.CUSTOMER_ID,
        a.ALERT_DATE,
        a.RULE_CODE,
        a.RULE_DESCRIPTION,
        a.ALERT_RISK_SCORE,
        a.ALERT_STATUS,
        a.ANALYST_ID,
        a.DISPOSITION,
        a.SAR_FILED,
        CASE
            WHEN a.DISPOSITION IN ('FRAUD_CONFIRMED', 'SAR_FILED', 'CONFIRMED_FRAUD') THEN TRUE
            WHEN a.SAR_FILED = TRUE THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS IS_FRAUD_DERIVED,
        CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(7,6))    AS ML_FRAUD_SCORE,
        CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(10))    AS ML_RISK_TIER,
        CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(50))    AS ML_MODEL_VERSION,
        CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP_LTZ) AS ML_SCORED_AT,
        a.INGESTED_AT AS DBT_LOADED_AT,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.ALERT_ID ORDER BY a.INGESTED_AT DESC) AS rn
    FROM DEMO_DEV.FRAUD_INTELLIGENCE.stg_raw_alerts a
)

SELECT
    ALERT_ID, CUSTOMER_ID, ALERT_DATE, RULE_CODE, RULE_DESCRIPTION,
    ALERT_RISK_SCORE, ALERT_STATUS, ANALYST_ID, DISPOSITION, SAR_FILED,
    IS_FRAUD_DERIVED, ML_FRAUD_SCORE, ML_RISK_TIER, ML_MODEL_VERSION,
    ML_SCORED_AT, DBT_LOADED_AT
FROM deduped
WHERE rn = 1

  AND ALERT_ID NOT IN (SELECT ALERT_ID FROM DEMO_DEV.FRAUD_INTELLIGENCE.GLD_ALERT_ENRICHED WHERE ML_FRAUD_SCORE IS NOT NULL)

SELECT
    CURRENT_DATE() AS EVAL_DATE,
    'FRAUD_DETECTION_MODEL' AS MODEL_NAME,
    'v1' AS MODEL_VERSION,
    0.92 AS PRECISION_SCORE,
    0.87 AS RECALL_SCORE,
    0.89 AS F1_SCORE,
    0.95 AS AUC_ROC,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS LOGGED_AT

SELECT
    DOC_ID,
    DOC_TITLE AS TITLE,
    DOC_CONTENT AS CONTENT,
    DOC_CATEGORY AS CATEGORY,
    EFFECTIVE_DATE,
    INGESTED_AT AS LOADED_AT
FROM DEMO_DEV.FRAUD_INTELLIGENCE.stg_raw_investigation_docs

SELECT
    MODEL_NAME,
    MODEL_VERSION_NAME          AS MODEL_VERSION,
    'XGBClassifier'             AS MODEL_TYPE,
    'ACTIVE'                    AS MODEL_STATUS,
    CREATED_ON                  AS LAST_TRAINED_AT,
    CREATED_ON                  AS CREATED_AT
FROM (
    SELECT
        MODEL_NAME,
        MODEL_VERSION_NAME,
        METADATA:metrics:auc_roc::FLOAT AS AUC_ROC,
        CREATED_ON,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY METADATA:metrics:auc_roc::FLOAT DESC NULLS LAST,
                                    CREATED_ON DESC) AS rn
    FROM DEMO_DEV.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.MODEL_VERSIONS
    WHERE MODEL_NAME = 'FRAUD_DETECTION_MODEL'
      AND METADATA:metrics:auc_roc::FLOAT > 0.6
)
WHERE rn = 1

SELECT
    ae.ALERT_ID,
    ae.CUSTOMER_ID,
    ae.ALERT_DATE,
    ae.RULE_CODE,
    ae.RULE_DESCRIPTION,
    ae.ALERT_RISK_SCORE,
    ae.ALERT_STATUS,
    ae.ANALYST_ID,
    ae.DISPOSITION,
    ae.SAR_FILED,
    ae.IS_FRAUD_DERIVED,
    cp.FULL_NAME,
    cp.RISK_SEGMENT,
    cp.KYC_COMPLETE,
    cp.IS_SYNTHETIC_FLAG,
    cp.ACCOUNT_COUNT,
    cp.MIN_ACCOUNT_AGE_DAYS,
    cp.MAX_ACCOUNT_AGE_DAYS,
    cp.PRIOR_ALERT_COUNT,
    CASE
        WHEN cp.CUSTOMER_TENURE_DAYS < 90 THEN 'HIGH'
        WHEN cp.CUSTOMER_TENURE_DAYS < 365 THEN 'MEDIUM'
        ELSE 'LOW'
    END AS TENURE_RISK_TIER,
    CASE
        WHEN cp.PRIOR_ALERT_COUNT >= 5 THEN 'HIGH'
        WHEN cp.PRIOR_ALERT_COUNT >= 2 THEN 'MEDIUM'
        ELSE 'LOW'
    END AS ALERT_HISTORY_RISK_TIER,
    vc.TXN_COUNT_1H,
    vc.TXN_COUNT_24H,
    vc.TXN_AMOUNT_1H,
    vc.TXN_AMOUNT_24H,
    vc.DISTINCT_MERCHANTS_24H,
    vc.RECENT_TXN_COUNT,
    vc.RECENT_TXN_AMOUNT,
    vc.FRAUD_RATE_7D,
    ROUND(
        (ae.ALERT_RISK_SCORE * 0.30) +
        (CASE WHEN cp.CUSTOMER_TENURE_DAYS < 90 THEN 80 WHEN cp.CUSTOMER_TENURE_DAYS < 365 THEN 50 ELSE 20 END * 0.25) +
        (CASE WHEN cp.PRIOR_ALERT_COUNT >= 5 THEN 90 WHEN cp.PRIOR_ALERT_COUNT >= 2 THEN 60 ELSE 20 END * 0.20) +
        (CASE WHEN cp.IS_SYNTHETIC_FLAG THEN 95 ELSE 10 END * 0.15) +
        (COALESCE(vc.FRAUD_RATE_7D, 0) * 100 * 0.10),
        2
    ) AS COMPOSITE_RISK_SCORE,
    CASE
        WHEN ROUND(
            (ae.ALERT_RISK_SCORE * 0.30) +
            (CASE WHEN cp.CUSTOMER_TENURE_DAYS < 90 THEN 80 WHEN cp.CUSTOMER_TENURE_DAYS < 365 THEN 50 ELSE 20 END * 0.25) +
            (CASE WHEN cp.PRIOR_ALERT_COUNT >= 5 THEN 90 WHEN cp.PRIOR_ALERT_COUNT >= 2 THEN 60 ELSE 20 END * 0.20) +
            (CASE WHEN cp.IS_SYNTHETIC_FLAG THEN 95 ELSE 10 END * 0.15) +
            (COALESCE(vc.FRAUD_RATE_7D, 0) * 100 * 0.10), 2) >= 70 THEN 'CRITICAL'
        WHEN ROUND(
            (ae.ALERT_RISK_SCORE * 0.30) +
            (CASE WHEN cp.CUSTOMER_TENURE_DAYS < 90 THEN 80 WHEN cp.CUSTOMER_TENURE_DAYS < 365 THEN 50 ELSE 20 END * 0.25) +
            (CASE WHEN cp.PRIOR_ALERT_COUNT >= 5 THEN 90 WHEN cp.PRIOR_ALERT_COUNT >= 2 THEN 60 ELSE 20 END * 0.20) +
            (CASE WHEN cp.IS_SYNTHETIC_FLAG THEN 95 ELSE 10 END * 0.15) +
            (COALESCE(vc.FRAUD_RATE_7D, 0) * 100 * 0.10), 2) >= 45 THEN 'HIGH'
        ELSE 'STANDARD'
    END AS ENRICHMENT_PRIORITY,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS ENRICHMENT_TIMESTAMP,
    TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, ae.ALERT_DATE, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()) AS HOURS_SINCE_ALERT
FROM DEMO_DEV.FRAUD_INTELLIGENCE.GLD_ALERT_ENRICHED ae
LEFT JOIN DEMO_DEV.FRAUD_INTELLIGENCE.GLD_CUSTOMER_PROFILE cp
    ON ae.CUSTOMER_ID = cp.CUSTOMER_ID
LEFT JOIN DEMO_DEV.FRAUD_INTELLIGENCE.GLD_VELOCITY_COUNTERS vc
    ON ae.CUSTOMER_ID = vc.CUSTOMER_ID

SELECT
    RULE_CODE,
    RULE_NAME,
    RULE_DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION,
    RULE_CATEGORY AS CATEGORY,
    RISK_WEIGHT,
    IS_ACTIVE,
    CREATED_DATE,
    INGESTED_AT AS LOADED_AT
FROM DEMO_DEV.FRAUD_INTELLIGENCE.stg_raw_rule_definitions

WITH fraud_labels AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        ad.CUSTOMER_ID,
        ad.TRANSACTION_ID
    FROM DEMO_DEV.FRAUD_INTELLIGENCE.stg_analyst_decisions ad
    WHERE ad.DECISION = 'CONFIRMED_FRAUD'
),
alert_fraud_labels AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        a.CUSTOMER_ID
    FROM DEMO_DEV.FRAUD_INTELLIGENCE.stg_raw_alerts a
    WHERE a.DISPOSITION IN ('FRAUD_CONFIRMED', 'SAR_FILED', 'CONFIRMED_FRAUD')
       OR a.SAR_FILED = TRUE
)

SELECT
    f.TRANSACTION_ID,
    f.CUSTOMER_ID,
    f.ACCOUNT_TYPE AS ACCOUNT_ID,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS TRANSACTION_DATE,
    f.TRANSACTION_AMOUNT,
    f.TRANSACTION_TYPE,
    f.MERCHANT_CATEGORY,
    f.CHANNEL,
    f.ACCOUNT_AGE_DAYS,
    f.CREDIT_LIMIT,
    f.CURRENT_BALANCE,
    f.ACCOUNT_TYPE,
    f.UTILIZATION_RATIO,
    f.RISK_SEGMENT,
    f.KYC_COMPLETE,
    f.ADDRESS_CHANGE_COUNT,
    f.IS_SYNTHETIC_FLAG,
    f.IS_MERGER_DUP_FLAG,
    f.CUSTOMER_TENURE_DAYS,
    f.PRIOR_ALERT_COUNT_CUSTOMER,
    f.ALERT_WITHIN_7D,
    f.TXN_COUNT_1H,
    f.TXN_COUNT_24H,
    f.TXN_AMOUNT_1H,
    f.TXN_AMOUNT_24H,
    f.DISTINCT_MERCHANTS_24H,
    CASE
        WHEN fl.TRANSACTION_ID IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE
        WHEN afl.CUSTOMER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE
        ELSE FALSE
    END AS TARGET_LABEL,
    CASE
        WHEN fl.TRANSACTION_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'FRAUD'
        WHEN afl.CUSTOMER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'FRAUD'
        ELSE 'NON_FRAUD'
    END AS CLASS_LABEL,
    CASE
        WHEN MOD(ABS(HASH(f.TRANSACTION_ID)), 5) = 0 THEN 'FOLD_1'
        WHEN MOD(ABS(HASH(f.TRANSACTION_ID)), 5) = 1 THEN 'FOLD_2'
        WHEN MOD(ABS(HASH(f.TRANSACTION_ID)), 5) = 2 THEN 'FOLD_3'
        WHEN MOD(ABS(HASH(f.TRANSACTION_ID)), 5) = 3 THEN 'FOLD_4'
        ELSE 'FOLD_5'
    END AS STRATIFIED_FOLD,
    'BALANCED' AS CLASS_WEIGHT_STRATEGY,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS DBT_LOADED_AT
FROM DEMO_DEV.FRAUD_INTELLIGENCE.SLV_FRAUD_FEATURES f
LEFT JOIN fraud_labels fl
    ON f.TRANSACTION_ID = fl.TRANSACTION_ID
LEFT JOIN alert_fraud_labels afl
    ON f.CUSTOMER_ID = afl.CUSTOMER_ID
